description: End a release gate run that is still waiting on its tests. Its decision becomes cancelled, which fails the deploy in CI; tests that finished keep their verdicts and the rest are marked cancelled. The test runs it started keep going (stop them with stop_runs). Use it for a gate run stuck as running, or one the user no longer needs. A run still open past its gate's CI time limit is ended on its own, as failed.

gate_run_number.description: The gate run's number, as list_gate_runs shows it.
gate_run_number.title: Gate Run Number

name: cancel_gate_run
